rendered:
1. Timing: According to the US Advanced Battery Consortium standards, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity falls below 80%[1] of its rated capacity.[2]
2. Options: End-of-life EV batteries can be reused or repurposed, recycled, or disposed of in landfills, which the review says would cause serious environmental issues.[3][4]
   Repurposing reconfigures the batteries for a second life in applications such as grid energy storage and behind-the-meter energy storage.[5]
3. Required end step: Regardless of whether batteries are reused, the review says they will eventually need to be recycled.[6]
